reason: The abstract establishes in the RESULTS section that "supratentorial (n = 21) and infratentorial atrophy (n = 20)" are findings on initial brain MR imaging in patients with neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses. The CONCLUSIONS section then states "CLN2, CLN5, and CLN7 diseases showed predominant cerebellar-over-cerebral atrophy." Supratentorial atrophy is cerebral (cortical) atrophy. The abstract clearly establishes that CLN5 disease is part of the cohort studied and exhibits cerebellar-over-cerebral atrophy patterns. While the quoted sentence does not explicitly state "CLN5 has supratentorial atrophy," the abstract establishes that CLN5 disease was part of the cohort with these neuroimaging findings, and the pattern described (cerebellar-over-cerebral atrophy) inherently indicates supratentorial (cerebral) involvement. This satisfies accept_inferred criteria: the finding clearly belongs to CLN5 disease as one of the three disease subtypes explicitly mentioned in the conclusion as showing this phenotype.
